# brimstone_intl_data

Baked [ICU4X](https://icu.unicode.org/) data for the `Intl` implementation in `brimstone_core`,
plus the list of locales that data was generated for. It is a separate crate so that building the
JS engine does not recompile the generated tables, and its output is checked in.

Contents:

- `src/data/` - generated by `icu4x-datagen`: locale aliases and parents, likely subtags, script
  directions, and the collation and NFD tables `Intl.Collator` compares with. Markers are listed in
  `icu/intl_markers.txt`.
- `src/built_in.rs` - the locale set, as `BUILT_IN_LOCALES` and `DEFAULT_LOCALE`.
- `src/provider.rs` - `IntlDataProvider`, the provider to pass to the ICU4X `_unstable`
  constructors, e.g. `LocaleCanonicalizer::try_new_extended_unstable(&IntlDataProvider)`.

## Regenerating

Run from anywhere in the repo (it writes into this crate):

```
icu/generate_intl_data.sh
```

## Changing the locale set

One command, with the comma separated list of locales to build in. `en` must be in the list: it is
the locale `Intl` falls back to when none of the requested locales is built in, and
`resolvedOptions()` reports the locale that was actually used.

```
LUCINAJS_INTL_LOCALES=en,da,it,de,sv icu/generate_intl_data.sh
```

Then rebuild. The default, used when the variable is unset, is `en,da,it`.

## Versions and licence

The script installs `icu4x-datagen` 2.3.0 into `$CARGO_BIN_DIR` (default
`$WORK_DIR/lucinanet/js-engine/cargo-bin`), the same way `icu/generate_data.sh` does for the
Unicode data. The version must match the `icu_*` pins in the workspace `Cargo.toml`; moving the
pins means regenerating both this crate and `icu/data`.

The data is CLDR and Unicode data, distributed under the Unicode License v3 (Unicode-3.0); keep the
Unicode notice in the third-party licence file when shipping it.
